## Note — a probe mutated a tracked doc, deliberately kept

Probing `rank_task_subagents.py --help` (to prove A5's step is invocable) **ran it** — the script takes
no `--help`. It regenerated `TASK_SUBAGENT_SELECTION.md`. The change is a FORWARD regeneration
(`research` n 234→251, `review` n 6985→7051, picking up rows scored earlier today) and the freshness
guard confirms it is a KEEP, not a rewind. Kept and committed, because it is exactly what A5 now does
daily — but recorded here because a probe should not silently mutate a fleet-relevant artifact.
